findings.title: queued timestamp is frozen at import time
findings.body: AssignmentSource.queued uses a bare default of timezone.now(), which Python evaluates once when the class is defined, not on each instance. Every source built via from_integration() therefore shares the same import-time timestamp, and to_dict() persists that stale value into the Celery payload. Use field(default_factory=timezone.now) if queued is meant to record when the assignment was enqueued; as written the field cannot distinguish rapid successive assignee changes.

findings.title: AssignmentSource dict is not safe to round-trip through Celery
findings.body: sync_group_assignee_outbound passes assignment_source.to_dict() straight into sync_assignee_outbound.apply_async. asdict() includes queued as a datetime. A JSON task serializer either raises TypeError (so the outbound task is never enqueued, and other linked integrations never get the assignee update) or stringifies the datetime. from_dict() then does cls(**input_dict) and only recovers a source if construction does not throw; it never parses an ISO timestamp back into a datetime, and any TypeError/ValueError returns None. The worker then calls should_sync with no source and the originating integration is not skipped, so the sync cycle this PR is meant to stop still happens after a real queue hop. The new tests run under self.tasks() eager execution, which passes the dict in-process and does not catch this.

findings.title: Cycle guard drops sync to every issue on the source integration
findings.body: should_sync returns False for the whole installation when sync_source.integration_id matches org_integration.integration_id. Outbound fan-out is per ExternalIssue, but the guard has no external-issue key, so an inbound assignee change on one linked ticket suppresses outbound assignee sync for every other ticket on that same integration. A group linked to two Jira issues will leave the sibling ticket stale. It also still echoes the change to every other issue-sync integration, so two integrations with both inbound and outbound assignee sync enabled can ping-pong the assignee between themselves.
